Working tree clean (only the two stage-log JSONs the harness writes). Stage complete.

## Run 91 — frontend QA

**One real bug fixed**, recovered from the previous stage's capped run.

### The fix — `5a3978e`
`git status` was the first thing I ran, and it paid off: s1 capped at 51 turns leaving a complete, uncommitted fix in the tree. `updateMilestone` bound `req.body.completed` straight into `SET completed = $3`, so a partial PATCH sent `NULL` and wiped the flag. That's a live user path — `WorkOrdersView.jsx:97` uploads a milestone photo with `{ photo_url }` alone, so **attaching a photo to a finished milestone marked it incomplete and lost its timestamp**.

One thing worth flagging: the end-to-end repro **passed 4/4 on first run**, which read as "no bug." It was misleading — s1 had already restarted the server (file mtime 05:10:12, server start 05:10:32), so I was measuring the post-fix state. I proved it instead by running the old and new SQL directly against one existing row: **old wipes, new preserves.** Row restored, restore verified.

### Two carried gaps closed
- **`/admin`'s 403 is confirmed intentional.** It sat on the "documented-intentional" list for five runs on an *unproven* hypothesis. Ran the probe s4 wrote and never got to: `super_admin` → 200 on all four admin endpoints, `admin` (what the browser actually sends) → 403. Correct authorization; the page renders only because the dev bypass shows a `super_admin` user in the SPA.
- **The `validateId` bug class doesn't exist here** — 0 of 109 routes. I self-tested that set difference against two planted defects first and it caught both; a zero from an unvalidated harness would have meant nothing.

### Frontend coverage
19/19 routes render with **0 page errors and 0 console errors**, all 15 Settings tabs clean, and I got inside the modals and builders for the first time — the gap Run 90 named as most valuable. Estimate builder math verified live (3 × $250 = $750, subtotal/total/preview all correct), milestone toggle 0/7 → 1/7 → reverted, leads search/sort confirmed via outgoing query params, dashboard cards navigate, all 5 app storm-map layers toggle. **No new UI defects — 10th consecutive converged run.** Build passes; **net-zero DB writes**, verified (0 rows created, 0 stray records, milestone restored).

Two candidates died on inspection rather than becoming tickets: `/contracts` "Send Contract" disabled is just `!customerEmail` validation, and four "create" buttons are inline view swaps, not modals — a modal-only detector reports those as dead buttons.

**Left undone, deliberately:** three of s1's harnesses are still unrun (no output files — I checked). I committed them so the authoring cost isn't lost again, and flagged `.qa-r91-realidwrite.mjs` in the handoff as the highest-value remaining item — it targets the documented blind spot behind two of the last five real bugs, but it performs writes, so it needs a careful read before running rather than a blind execution at the end of a stage.
